summary: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` on `npm install`, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a shuffled numeric/string constants table and a string-array rotation decoder (`WV8StW`), with no plaintext logic. The advertised purpose of the package is a typed-css-modules webpack loader, which has no need for an alternate language runtime or a multi-hundred-KB obfuscated bundle executed at install time. The `@ornikar`-scoped package is a trojanized variant of the upstream `olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader`, which does not contain `setup.mjs`, `math_init.js`, or a preinstall lifecycle hook. Installing the package causes arbitrary code — the obfuscated payload — to execute under the installing user's privileges via a runtime the package fetches specifically to bypass Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
